t-SNE and UMAP: which structure survives?

Two pictures of the same data. Change a parameter in one of them, predict what will happen, then look. Click a point to see its 10 true neighbours in both.
Embeddings are precomputed (scikit-learn t-SNE with PCA initialisation, umap-learn 0.5; fixed seeds). Trustworthiness T drops when strangers end up as neighbours (false gluing); continuity C drops when true neighbours are torn apart; both use 10 neighbours. Clusters are found by HDBSCAN (minimum cluster size 15) on the 2D picture, and gray points are left unassigned. Other seeds exist only for the default parameters (t-SNE perplexity 30; UMAP n_neighbors 15, min_dist 0.1).
